Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. As our Celonis Customer Organization Enablement & Programs Intern, you will sit at the intersection of talent development, operational excellence, and customer success. CCO Enablement serves as the foundational backbone across these groups, supporting their end-to-end learning journeys—from seamless onboarding to advanced skill building. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to plan, execute, and monitor projects that standardize best practices and scale our organization’s collective expertise.

The Role:

In this role, you will serve as a central operational anchor for enablement and programs designed to scale the capabilities of our customer-facing teams. You will facilitate clear communication between different CCO departments, maintain centralized resource hubs, help structure project documentation and status reports. By synthesizing post-training evaluations and monitoring key performance indicators, you will provide actionable insights that help refine training curriculum, improve project delivery workflows, and support the ongoing growth of our global organization. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with teams and key stakeholders from across GTM and Celonis, giving you a whole perspective of how Celonis brings value to our customers as well as internally.

  • Create & Maintain Communications & Assets: you’ll get to own and design content, process and structure for ensuring proper management of materials and communications channels.
  • Coordinate and organize workshops, enablements and training programs: you’ll have the opportunity to work with teams across GTM/Celonis to coordinate global and regional sessions, content preparation, communications, and post-session success reporting for onboarding & upskilling live sessions. 
  • Support Stakeholder Management: partner with CCO Enablement team members and subject matter experts for requirements gathering and feedback on enablement program effectiveness & prioritization.
  • Program Analysis & Reporting: analyze program compliance and produce reports for leadership review; understand business needs to assess effectiveness
  • Support the execution of strategic learning programs: work alongside senior members of the team to help them drive effective program design, management and deliver a best-in-class enablement experience.

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era:

  • You will learn to work with AI agents and tools as one of your primary tools, focusing on creating new automations, ways of working and frameworks.
  • You will develop foundational specification and context skills to help translate business needs into precise AI instructions.

Based purely on merit and academic excellence, graduating high school students will be invited to interview, and select applicants will receive a Meritocracy Fellowship. Those that excel will obtain offers to join Palantir full time.

Skip the debt. Get the real education. Earn the Palantir degree.
